description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1864/15 of 26.05.2014, Homagama D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 520026 and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette exclusively contains amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It deals with specific modifications to land parcel details including parcel numbers, land extents, title classifications, ownership details, and encumbrances for multiple properties across different districts. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
